verdict.rationale: Bitbucket docs explicitly claim centralized visibility across pipeline status, testing policies, and deployment environments organization-wide, plus policy enforcement across teams/repos, supporting a devops-lead's cross-org CI/CD oversight needs. However, this is vendor-only messaging with no independent/hands-on corroboration of a dashboard or reporting UI, and no detail on cross-workspace/multi-repo aggregation depth. Missing for 10: independent verification of the centralized visibility dashboard, detail on cross-project/workspace aggregation, and hands-on user confirmation.
